title: Aromatic Smoky Greek Lentils Stew
description: A hearty, smoky lentil stew with Greek herbs, mirin sweetness, and a hint of dark chocolate for depth.
instructions: Rinse the red lentils under cold water until water runs clear.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the diced onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for one minute until fragrant.
Stir in the diced carrot and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, ground cumin, and dried oregano, stirring for 30 seconds.
Pour in the diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, and mirin, and bring to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender.
Remove the pot from heat and gently fold in the dark chocolate pieces until melted and fully incorporated.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
